3. identityConsistency: 3 - The player is recognizable by his green/white stripes and armband, but facial features and body shape morph significantly.
4. motionFidelity: 2 - The subtle forward lean in the original is lost; the stylized version shows erratic geometric shifts rather than natural movement.
5. sceneFidelity: 4 - The goal net, grass, and background elements maintain their relative spatial positions across all images.
6. stylizationStrength: 5 - The transformation into a distinct, high-contrast low-poly game aesthetic is very clear and consistent.
